title: nephrodium asplenioides subsp. reptans
intro: Nephrodium asplenioides subsp. reptans, commonly known as the reptan nephrolepis, is a fern species that belongs to the Nephrolepis genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The reptan nephrolepis is said to possess health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an anti-spasmodic agent due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
